title: Meet Quince Crogan

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: Yes, what is it? I don't cater to humans you know, only appliances.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, what is it? I don't cater to humans you know, only appliances.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: Well, that's what they are. Chattering machines. Now what do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, that's what they are. Chattering machines. Now what do you want?

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: No, I'm Nivalis' leading synthetic gastro-intestinal specialist.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I'm Nivalis' leading synthetic gastro-intestinal specialist.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: "Gut broker" is what they call me on the street. But when their alimentary mods clog up or their intestinal sump valves stop filtering, it’s all “please, Mr Crogan".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Gut broker" is what they call me on the street. But when their alimentary mods clog up or their intestinal sump valves stop filtering, it’s all “please, Mr Crogan".

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: Oh, one of those mealy-mouthed meeter-greeter units.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, one of those mealy-mouthed meeter-greeter units.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: Maybe they're built just how I like them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe they're built just how I like them.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: They're not people. They're machines who think drinking coffee and eating donuts will make them human. Pathetic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They're not people. They're machines who think drinking coffee and eating donuts will make them human. Pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: Of course you do. Which part?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course you do. Which part?

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: My problem is twenty years ago my skills would have taken me to the Spire.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My problem is twenty years ago my skills would have taken me to the Spire.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: You'll be back. Like the rest of them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll be back. Like the rest of them.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: As it so happens, I do. It's a common enough request.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As it so happens, I do. It's a common enough request.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: You do? Well too bad I only have one left. Which I'm saving. For good friends only. Now, if you'll excuse me...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You do? Well too bad I only have one left. Which I'm saving. For good friends only. Now, if you'll excuse me...

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: You know, you're not so bad. You're not a ferroequinologist, are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, you're not so bad. You're not a ferroequinologist, are you?

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: Ferro, as in iron, equine as in horse? It's what folk used to call us rail enthusiasts. If it wasn't for my debt, that's where I'd be, in the Metro Hub with a NATA-log...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ferro, as in iron, equine as in horse? It's what folk used to call us rail enthusiasts. If it wasn't for my debt, that's where I'd be, in the Metro Hub with a NATA-log...

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: Trains are the only good thing about this city. All of that sublime steel. If it wasn't for my debt that's where I'd be, in the metro hub, with a NATA-log.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Trains are the only good thing about this city. All of that sublime steel. If it wasn't for my debt that's where I'd be, in the metro hub, with a NATA-log.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: Condemned by the sins of my fathers to be locked down here with a deranged killer. Not even a train ride for comfort. Don't tell anyone, will you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Condemned by the sins of my fathers to be locked down here with a deranged killer. Not even a train ride for comfort. Don't tell anyone, will you?

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: No! About my debt! This Aseptic character is an android, mark my words. Probably one that hates my guts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No! About my debt! This Aseptic character is an android, mark my words. Probably one that hates my guts.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: Watch your back! No one's going to watch it for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Watch your back! No one's going to watch it for you.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: Uh. That stupid story again. Look, I know every inch of the tracks in this part of the city and I've never even seen a whisper of it. Now, if you don't mind, some of us have work to do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uh. That stupid story again. Look, I know every inch of the tracks in this part of the city and I've never even seen a whisper of it. Now, if you don't mind, some of us have work to do.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: You can be assured that I will.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can be assured that I will.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: Instead, I'm stuck selling plastic guts to glorified vacuum cleaners. Now say what you want, or push off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Instead, I'm stuck selling plastic guts to glorified vacuum cleaners. Now say what you want, or push off.

nodes.speaker: Quince Crogan
nodes.text: Those things break down faster than black market dermis. No wonder the Corp dropped them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Those things break down faster than black market dermis. No wonder the Corp dropped them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "Appliances"? Really?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Appliances"? Really?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're the Gut-Broker?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're the Gut-Broker?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nothing from you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing from you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right. A Gut Broker.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. A Gut Broker.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe you should build your parts better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you should build your parts better.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe you should build your parts better.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe you should build your parts better.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need a part for a friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need a part for a friend.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need a part for a friend.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need a part for a friend.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So do you have the part?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So do you have the part?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So do you have the part?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So do you have the part?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You know what? Forget it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know what? Forget it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: To break down so people have to keep coming back?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To break down so people have to keep coming back?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: To break down so people have to keep coming back?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: To break down so people have to keep coming back?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's your problem?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's your problem?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Look, I just need a part.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I just need a part.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Look, I just need a part.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Look, I just need a part.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A logic relay for a Third Gen LifeCorp Custodial Hospitality Model.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A logic relay for a Third Gen LifeCorp Custodial Hospitality Model.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: A logic relay for a Third Gen LifeCorp Custodial Hospitality Model.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A logic relay for a Third Gen LifeCorp Custodial Hospitality Model.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I'll take my business elsewhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I'll take my business elsewhere.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I'll take my business elsewhere.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I'll take my business elsewhere.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need a logic relay for a a 3rd Gen LifeCorp Custodial Hospitality Model.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need a logic relay for a a 3rd Gen LifeCorp Custodial Hospitality Model.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need a logic relay for a a 3rd Gen LifeCorp Custodial Hospitality Model.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need a logic relay for a a 3rd Gen LifeCorp Custodial Hospitality Model.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mean a train enthusiast?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean a train enthusiast?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ferro-what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ferro-what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you a Gen Debtor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you a Gen Debtor?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: About the trains?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: About the trains?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, good luck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, good luck.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you ever heard of a secret metro station called "Egress"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you ever heard of a secret metro station called "Egress"?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you ever heard of a secret metro station called "Egress"?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you ever heard of a secret metro station called "Egress"?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds less frightening when explained.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds less frightening when explained.
